classes.name: VersionScriptParser
classes.description: Parser class for processing version scripts, handling symbol visibility, exclusions, architecture, and API level filtering.

classes.name: ExportedSymbolSet
classes.description: Data structure representing parsed symbols, including functions, variables, C++ demangled symbols, and glob patterns.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a version script input stream and returns a set of exported symbols.

methods.name: AddExcludedSymbolVersion
methods.description: Adds a symbol version to the exclusion list.

methods.name: SetArch
methods.description: Sets the target architecture for symbol filtering.

methods.name: SetApiLevel
methods.description: Sets the API level for symbol filtering.

methods.name: GetFunctions
methods.description: Retrieves the map of function symbols.

methods.name: GetVars
methods.description: Retrieves the map of variable symbols.

methods.name: GetDemangledCppSymbols
methods.description: Retrieves the set of demangled C++ symbols.

methods.name: GetDemangledCppGlobPatterns
methods.description: Retrieves the set of C++ glob patterns.

methods.name: GetGlobPatterns
methods.description: Retrieves the set of glob patterns for symbols.
